sections.title: Current
sections.body: I currently work at YouWare as an AI Engineer. YouWare is the world's first vibe coders' community. I am also a Cursor ambassador, having held 10+ events in China with thousands of attendees.

sections.title: Fun facts
sections.body:
- Bachelor's in physics, master's in acoustics; learned to code after starting my career
- Performed live coding and circuit bending shows in Beijing
- Have two cats and once had a lizard
- Worked at Douban, was an active user, and was banned for supporting a protest
 - I tried to develop indie games in my free time, but haven't come up with anything complete yet
 - I choose this radio like approach, because I am a huge fan of radio stations like NTS and LYL.
- Started college at 14
